title: Garlic Butter Pork Chops
description: Tender pork chops seared and finished with garlic butter for an easy dinner that's packed with homemade flavor.
instructions: Season pork chops with salt, pepper, paprika, and thyme.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook pork chops 4 to 5 minutes per side.
Reduce heat and add butter and garlic.
Spoon garlic butter over the chops for 2 to 3 minutes.
notes: Serve with mashed potatoes or roasted vegetables.
Avoid overcooking to keep the meat juicy.
leftovers: Great sliced for sandwiches or salads.
whyWeChoseThis: Ready in 30 minutes, start to finish.
One skillet, easy for a weeknight.
Garlic butter turns basic pork chops into something special.
